briefdescription.para: Wave D Phase 1 release-gate benchmarks for geographic placement and cross-region WAL shipping.

sect2.title: Benchmark families

para.heading: GEO-BENCH-01 — Leader election under placement constraints (3-DC topology)

sect2.para: Gate: deterministic, ≤ 50 ms per election Workload: 100 elections in 3-DC cluster with placement constraints
Gate: ≥ 80 MB/s on simulated GbE link Workload: 10,000 × 1 KB segments enqueued and shipped

para.heading: WAL-BENCH-02 — Lag alert latency under backpressure

sect2.para: Gate: Alert fires within 2× max_lag_ms window (default 2s) Workload: Segment delayed to exceed max_lag_ms, alert fires
